description:
Cast Synth Infiltrator by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Honest Rutstein.
Put Honest Rutstein into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Synth Infiltrator triggers, returning Honest Rutstein from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Honest Rutstein by paying {0} due to Morophon and Synth Infiltrator.
Put Honest Rutstein into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Honest Rutstein triggers, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 4.
